schema_mapping.observed_parser_output: SanitizedFinancingEvent (transaction_id_redacted, instrument, trade_id_redacted, units, financing, time)
schema_mapping.overlay_input: PositionInterval from trade CSV (entry_time, exit_time, instrument, side, units)
schema_mapping.gap: Observed DAILY_FINANCING events are point-in-time charges, not hold-interval rates — bridge must aggregate observed events into per-(date, instrument) RatePair table for TableRateSource

per_position_financing: parser supports positionFinancings + openTradeFinancings when data exists
per_trade_financing: parser supports openTradeFinancings.tradeID + financing when data exists
conversion_factors: homeConversionFactors not present in empty capture; parser reserves extension point
bridge_description: Aggregate sanitized events → TableRateSource or ObservedRateSource mapping financing amounts to annual_bp per (date, instrument, side)
